decisions.decision: ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT realizes both defaults with no explicit backfill UPDATE
decisions.why: Since PG11 a non-volatile DEFAULT fills existing rows without a rewrite, so vehicles get Active from the clause alone. Verified against Postgres docs, not assumed.

decisions.decision: UpdateAccountLanguage filters status=Active, so a language switch on an inactive account silently no-ops
decisions.why: Consistent with Step 2's blanket filter. Harmless: an inactive account cannot reach the language switch, since login is refused before a session exists.

decisions.decision: database design gate confirmed: DDL, defaults and the no-new-index plan approved as proposed
decisions.why: User replied 'continue' to the presented DDL, index plan and D9 consequence without requesting changes.

decisions.decision: one serial worker for T1-T6 instead of six per-wave dispatches
decisions.why: The tasks form a linear chain in one module over overlapping files (query.sql, sqlc regen, service.go). Six dispatches would re-read the doc pack six times.
